scoring_notes: tier semantics per BenchMetrics: tier>=1 = recall gold; tier==2 = MRR target; nDCG gain 2^tier-1
FETCH tier policy: MS-seeking queries (answer/mark scheme/solution) -> MS chunks tier 2, QP chunks tier 1; QP-seeking ('what did question N ask') swapped (33 ms-primary / 7 qp-primary)
enumerate_paper: all QP-doc chunks tier 2, MS-doc chunks tier 1 (paper-level evidence)

substrate-absent classes (explain_spec, explain_note, enumerate_topic, enumerate_spec) carry empty gold_evidence BY DESIGN: their substrate is spec/notes/bank rows, which are NOT part of the snap-001 chunk corpus (2,333 paper chunks) — these are excluded from the chunk axis only (run-001/002 rule), never from spec resolution

explain_refusal probes carry empty gold_spec_points: BenchMetrics.scoreResolution returns coverage 0.0 for empty gold — a correct refusal and a total miss both read 0 on this axis; refusal correctness is gated separately (catalog meta.gates_plan_9). Recorded blind spot, not silently hidden.

evidence probes are deterministic text matches (qp_stem_probe >=30 chars, qp_furniture_probe 'total for question N', ms_marktext_probe >=25 chars); chunk content itself is frozen in snap-001 so probes are re-runnable offline

gold_spec_code_validation.note: A gold spec point whose snapshot node is not VALIDATED can never be matched by the production matcher (it matches VALIDATED structure nodes only) — listed here honestly instead of dropped.

hygiene_markers: session_label_raw / series_norm / label_variant_used document the Summer-vs-June mix (plan 8.1)
exam_papers has NO year column — year derived from session_label digits at eval time (strengthens 8.1)
FET null-code cases identify papers by unit+session+year (plan 8.2)

ALL 846 paper-linked questions are active=FALSE while 15/94 papers are VALIDATED — R4 Fetch/Enumerate SQL must define its active-policy; FETCH + ENUMERATE-C anchors are bank rows regardless of active, VALIDATED papers first
1,725 question_spec_points rows all sit on ACTIVE questions that have NO exam_paper_id (0/1725) — the spec-anchored and paper-anchored bank subsets are DISJOINT today (R3 bank-backfill design input)
Many multipart STRUCTURED questions carry an EMPTY questions.stem (text lives in question_parts) — EXP-A filters stems >40 chars; R3 question-card rendering must assemble stem from parts

gates_plan_9.EXPLAIN: recall@10 of expected spec refs among retrieved chunks + citation validity + refusal correctness
gates_plan_9.FETCH: 100% exact (series, year, paper, qnum) on the deterministic path (R4)
gates_plan_9.ENUMERATE: recall >= 0.95 and precision >= 0.90 vs SQL+card path
